verse.verse_2: striking sparks of fire with their hooves,
verse.verse_3: as they gallop to make raids at dawn,
verse.verse_5: forcing their way into the midst of the enemy,
verse.verse_6: surely, man is ungrateful to his Lord.
verse.verse_7: He himself bears witness to that.
verse.verse_8: Surely, he is ardent in his love of wealth.
verse.verse_9: Is he not aware of the time when the contents of the graves will be brought out?
verse.verse_10: And the hearts' contents shall be brought into the open?
verse.verse_11: Surely, on that Day, they will know that their Lord had full knowledge of them all.
